summary: Recorded the four-order receipt (251562364ca64b3c80cd14e0d6aeddc3, fixed experiment e25f403842234594881914f730efff4e-experiment, test TestAssuranceEPaxosRecoveryMixedQuorumOrder, 40 events, no diagnostics) into the account. The receipt makes the slow-quorum trigger observed rather than derived: the recoverer's leader-bookkeeping object is replaced on the second delivered peer reply in all four orders (indices 5, 15, 25, 35), and the fresh bookkeeping startPhase1 installs already holds the decided candidate (fresh_lb_cmds_len 1 when that reply carried the owner's command, 0 when it did not). Outcomes follow that position and nothing else: kept for orders 1,2,3,4 (index 9) and 3,1,4,2 (index 39) although the first delivered reply there carried nothing; command dropped for 1,3,4,2 (witness 19) where the first delivered reply carried the command but the trigger reply did not; and dropped for 3,4,1,2 (witness 29) where both command-carrying replies arrive after the trigger and cannot restore the command. Changes made: the interpretation for 0757162a-question-0 gained the new receipt in its executions, a paragraph stating the measured deciding position, a narrowed order-variant limitation (trigger position now observed, not derived; the three remaining permutations of the three-reply set still unenumerated), a new limit that the kept runs end PREACCEPTED with the command re-proposed, and a joint-history note tying the four receipts to one construction; the question's hypothesis and discriminator were restated so the 'more command-carrying than empty replies' half is recorded as measured in the negative; and the two statements that carried the derived wording - knowledge 2b0dd5bd (empty-slice adoption) and the recovery-value family fact bb3ff1d8 clause (d) - were sharpened to 'the adopted value is the one carried by the last reply appended before the appended count reaches SlowQuorumSize, the fabricated self reply counting toward it, with replies delivered after the trigger unable to restore the command', each with the new receipt cited. Validation: valid, no execution requested.
